## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical understanding of approximate distinct counting in streams, including memory-accuracy trade-offs and concrete update rules.

## Key Concepts
- Distinct counting in streams
- HyperLogLog sketch mechanics and error bounds
- Per-element update and batch processing costs

## Code Example

// Pseudo-code: update for one value x
let hash = hashFn(x);
let idx = hash >>> (32 - m bits);
let w = hash & ((1 << (32 - m)) - 1);
R[idx] = Math.max(R[idx], 1 + leadingZeros(w));
```

- How does choosing m affect latency on high-velocity streams?

- DAG properties and topological order

- Frontier-limited recomputation and memory-time tradeoffs

        if delta:
            paths_to[v][d] += delta
            enqueue_successors(v, d, delta)
```
